subject.title: [Feature]: Add Grok 4.5 to the xAI provider

question: Should OpenClaw add Grok 4.5 as a first-class bundled xAI model now while keeping Grok 4.3 as the setup default for regional safety?
rationale: The code change is likely small, but bundled provider catalogs and default live lanes are maintainer-owned product/provider decisions, and this issue already has the protected `maintainer` label.

options.title: Add Grok 4.5, keep 4.3 default
options.body: Publish Grok 4.5 and aliases with current metadata while preserving Grok 4.3 as the setup default until regional availability changes.

options.title: Wait for regional/default clarity
options.body: Hold the catalog update until xAI availability and launch docs are stable enough to avoid confusing EU API-key users.

options.title: Rely on live/custom discovery only
options.body: Do not add a bundled static entry yet, leaving advanced users to select Grok 4.5 through live discovery or explicit model config.

recommendation.title: Add Grok 4.5, keep 4.3 default
recommendation.body: Publish Grok 4.5 and aliases with current metadata while preserving Grok 4.3 as the setup default until regional availability changes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current assignee and prior xAI model-catalog owner for the Grok 4.3 default path.
